sku_type_complete.notes: skip any null/empty source; do NOT skip flavor when it equals 'Original'/'Plain' (unlike other categories, susu dict rows keep it, e.g. 'Healthy Way Kids 1+ Original 700 gr'); kemasan is 'SIZE UNITS' or 'SIZE UNITS x N pcs' when bundled, e.g. '700 gr' or '15 gr x 30 pcs'

keywords.notes: VERIFIED 2026-09-14 against live rows: keywords = keyword_typo + ' ' + sku_type_complete (e.g. keyword_typo 'Twin Pack' -> 'Twin Pack HiLo Teen Hi Protein Original 330 gr'; '1000 gram' -> '1000 gram HiLo Active Chocolate 1000 gr'). When keyword_typo is null the legacy rows keep a LEADING SPACE (' HiLo Calcium Chocolate 14 gr x 10 pcs') - that is data noise, do not replicate it; emit the bare sku_type_complete instead.
